text: {"lessons":["I should judge my investments as one portfolio, not as separate accounts whose losses I feel compelled to avoid realizing.","A few months of gains or declines are not enough to prove a stock is good or bad; I should review its fundamentals and risks before deciding to buy, sell, or hold.","Doing nothing avoids impulsive trades, but I should still check that my portfolio remains diversified and fits my goals and risk tolerance."]}
